summary: Take the first-seen statistical mode as background. Count every other color; let H be the smallest foreground-color count and W the largest. Create a 16x16 background canvas. Paint the first W columns of its bottom H rows color 2, then paint color 4 at the two clipped-diamond edge columns determined by W-H+row-index and its horizontal reflection.
